answer: Audits are published in jade, queued in cipher, and lantern publishes the wait time. A farm of 182 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 26 identities per epoch. A farm of 2099 identities would post 2025 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
